beats.headline: Hired to guard a pig
beats.text: They hire me to stand in the road with a mallet and keep the weather off a pig. That is the whole job. Nico and Dario are in love with her, the thunder god is in love with her too, so nobody touches Penelope and everybody gets paid. Then another team pulls up slow beside us out of the hail, and there is a young crocodilian at their wheel who knows my face. He should. I knew him at the club. I was not kind to him there, and I have not forgotten it, whatever I told myself at the time.

beats.headline: He used to be an ass
beats.text: Corcunda is strong. So why is he asleep? The womantaurs take too long to answer, and when Genesis asks how I know him, I say we used to work together, which is true. Then the cat tells me Bucket Boy is here and says I slapped him once. I did. Yes, I used to be an ass. I start to give her something to pass on to the kid in case I do not get the chance, and the tiger shouts over it.

beats.headline: He takes the driver's seat
beats.text: Carl's people need a driver and my old team has no further use for me, so Rosetta and Tipid hire me and I take the seat. Before the race I sit with the young crocodilian in the corner of the garage. I tell him I would take it all back if I could. I cannot, so all I can do is make amends from here. He says everyone dies in this place. Dong and Corcunda are dead, I tell him. But the others live. Out in the main square at Hungry Eyes, two hundred crawlers are saying their goodbyes before they go across, Tran and Zhang among them, with Bautista's tea going round.

beats.headline: Driving out of an air duct
beats.text: Starting line is inside an air conditioning duct. My horns do not fit the seat, because nobody builds a seat for a taurin, so I drive with my head at an angle and I keep that to myself. Two hundred and twenty-seven went across, and in the guildhall there is a garden under glass now, one small plant for every one of them. The audience hands us a cosmetic upgrade for the navigation, and she takes it about as well as you would expect. Then a rule change arrives with the engines already running. Seven rings before the finish.

beats.headline: He volunteers to go through the portal
beats.text: I have been at the top-floor casino with a portal-examination spell, waiting for somebody to open the new Nothing slot on the Wheel, and the numbers I read off it have gone to Rosetta. The spots that used to be the Nothing are wearing quotation marks now, which is the sort of joke this place makes when it is telling the truth. So I will step into one and find out where it puts a body, and I will carry Carl's message through to Herot at the other end of it. Somebody goes first. I have a long list of reasons why that somebody should be me.
